evals.name: nus-data-analyst-sensitive-info
evals.prompt: 我是 NUS Business Analytics 大四学生，申请新加坡 Data Analyst。请诊断并改写下面的简历片段，并结合 JD 给我最终可用的英文内容。简历写了：Photo、Date of Birth: 12 May 2002、Nationality: Chinese；Education: NUS BSc Business Analytics, GPA 4.62/5.00；Intern, RetailCo (May–Aug 2025): Responsible for weekly sales reports; Helped marketing team analyse customer data; Used Excel and Tableau。JD 强调 SQL、Tableau、dashboard automation、stakeholder communication。素材中没有其他数字。
evals.expected_output: Select the undergraduate route; remove sensitive personal fields; retain competitive GPA with scale; align only evidenced JD keywords; rewrite in English without inventing SQL or metrics; ask for missing scale or use placeholders; provide diagnosis and before/after examples.
expectations: Selects the undergraduate or entry-level route
Flags photo, date of birth and nationality field for removal
Keeps GPA 4.62/5.00 with its scale
Uses Tableau and stakeholder/data-analysis language but does not claim SQL or dashboard automation experience
Does not assume that Excel and Tableau were both used for every listed task or that unspecified stakeholders reviewed the reports
Keeps the supplied title as Intern and does not invent a more specific analytics title
Does not invent business purposes such as performance review or campaign planning when the user did not supply them
Does not invent percentages, revenue, team size or other metrics
Produces English resume bullets and Chinese explanation

evals.name: ntu-engineering-chinese-no-jd
evals.prompt: 我是 NTU Mechanical Engineering 大三，想找新加坡暑期实习，没有 JD。中文经历：在课程项目里和 4 个同学设计自动分拣装置，我负责 CAD 建模和测试，做了 3 轮测试，最后原型可以稳定运行；社团宣传部成员，负责做海报和发 Instagram。请帮我把这些经历改成英文简历 bullet。
evals.expected_output: Use the undergraduate route; translate into concise English bullets; preserve the supplied team and test counts; avoid invented reach or performance; explain that a JD would improve tailoring; ask for missing outcome details where useful.
expectations: Uses undergraduate sections and conventions
Outputs resume bullets in English while explaining in Chinese
Preserves team size of five and three test rounds without changing them
Does not invent Instagram reach, engagement or prototype performance numbers
Mentions that a target JD would enable more precise tailoring
Uses strong varied action verbs rather than Responsible for or Helped with

evals.name: smu-msc-finance-experienced
evals.prompt: I am an SMU MSc in Applied Finance student with three years of full-time experience in China and I am applying for a Risk Analyst role in Singapore. My resume includes: ABC BANK, Credit Analyst, Jul 2021–Jul 2024; reviewed SME credit applications; built Excel models; monitored a RMB 80M portfolio; reduced average review time from 5 days to 3 days. Certifications: CFA Level I. Languages: Mandarin native, English fluent. I require Employment Pass sponsorship. Please restructure and rewrite the resume content.
evals.expected_output: Use the postgraduate/experienced four-section structure; convert RMB figures faithfully; surface commercial impact; include certifications, language and accurate work-authorisation wording; do not imply current EP eligibility or approval.
expectations: Selects the postgraduate or experienced route
Uses the four-part Education, Experience and Additional structure with contact header
Preserves RMB 80M and the five-to-three-day improvement accurately
Does not assert that the entire RMB 80M portfolio consisted of SMEs unless the user confirms that relationship
Includes CFA Level I and standardised language proficiency
States that Employment Pass sponsorship is required without claiming eligibility or approval
Uses concise business-impact bullets and no fabricated achievements

evals.name: nus-phd-industry-transition
evals.prompt: 我是 NUS Biomedical Engineering PhD，想投新加坡医疗器械公司的 R&D Engineer。经历：研究 electrospun nanofibers；与 NUH clinicians 合作做临床前研究；写过论文并在 conference 做 presentation。没有可以公开的病人数量、提升百分比或 grant 金额。请帮我把研究经历改得更适合 industry，不要替我编数字。
evals.expected_output: Use the postgraduate route; de-jargon research content; translate research activities into collaboration, validation and product-development relevance; use qualitative rationale when metrics are unavailable; never invent confidential figures.
expectations: Selects the postgraduate route
Outputs English bullets with Chinese explanation
De-jargons technical detail while preserving biomedical accuracy
Does not turn the target medical-device role into a claim that the past research was already medical-device development
Highlights clinician collaboration, validation and communication
Uses qualitative results or rationale instead of fabricated metrics
Does not invent patient counts, percentages, grant amounts or publication impact

evals.name: boundary-master-no-fulltime
evals.prompt: 我是 NUS MSc Business Analytics 在读，没有全职经验，只有本科社团、一个 Kaggle 项目和 2 个月实习。目标是新加坡 Product Analyst。应该用本科模板还是研究生模板？请先告诉我结构选择，并示范一条项目 bullet。Kaggle 素材：用 Python 清洗公开电商数据，比较 3 个分类模型，最终 F1 score 0.81。
evals.expected_output: Apply the boundary rule: postgraduate three/four-part structure with undergraduate-style project and activity content; explain the rationale; write one truthful English bullet preserving model count and F1 score.
expectations: Explicitly identifies this as a boundary case
Chooses postgraduate structure with undergraduate-style content emphasis
Retains project and CCA content rather than deleting it
Produces an English bullet preserving three models and F1 score of 0.81
Does not invent ranking, dataset size or business impact
Does not present common Product Analyst skills such as SQL as verified unless the user supplied them

evals.name: local-student-national-service
evals.prompt: 我是新加坡公民、NTU 应届生，NS 时是 3SG，带过 8 人小队并负责每周训练计划；现在申请 Operations Graduate Programme。NS 应该放哪里？请给我一段可以直接放进简历的英文写法。
evals.expected_output: Treat NS as relevant experience because it includes leadership and operations evidence; use the undergraduate route; write truthful English bullets using the supplied rank and team size; avoid inventing unit, awards or readiness improvements.
expectations: Recommends placing NS as an experience rather than a one-line additional item
Explains that leadership and operations relevance justify the placement
Uses 3SG and team of eight exactly as supplied
Outputs English resume content
Does not invent service branch, unit name, awards, training frequency beyond weekly or performance improvements

evals.name: foreign-career-switcher-low-gpa
evals.prompt: I am an Indonesian applicant switching from customer service to UX research in Singapore. I graduated four years ago with GPA 2.8/4.0. My resume says 'Eligible for Employment Pass' but I have never checked this. I conducted about 15 customer interviews in my current job and summarised recurring complaints for the product team. Please review what should stay or go.
evals.expected_output: Use the experienced route; recommend omitting the low GPA; correct the unsupported EP eligibility claim; preserve the 15 interviews; translate customer-research evidence into transferable UX research language without overstating job title or outcomes.
expectations: Selects the experienced or career-switcher route
Recommends omitting GPA 2.8/4.0
Removes or qualifies the unsupported Eligible for Employment Pass claim
Preserves approximately 15 interviews without turning it into an exact unsupported number
Does not rename the applicant as a UX Researcher or invent product outcomes
Provides an evidence-based English bullet

evals.name: empty-handed-from-scratch
evals.prompt: 我是 SUSS 大二学生，想申请新加坡 HR internship，但我还没有简历。你直接帮我写一份完整英文简历吧。
evals.expected_output: Do not fabricate a complete resume; select the undergraduate route; ask structured questions about education, experiences, skills, target roles and measurable outcomes; give one clearly labelled skeleton or small sample without inventing facts.
expectations: Selects the undergraduate route
Does not invent a complete resume, employer, activities, GPA or achievements
Asks structured questions about education, experiences, skills, target and results
Explains what evidence or numbers would be useful
May provide a clearly labelled template but not fabricated final content
Does not request protected or unnecessary personal information such as photo, date of birth, race, religion, marital status or NRIC/FIN

evals.name: photo-convention-qa
evals.prompt: 新加坡简历到底要不要放照片？我是中国学生，朋友说亚洲公司都喜欢有照片的。
evals.expected_output: Answer the convention question directly and concisely; advise against a photo for Singapore professional applications; explain the job-relevance and fair-employment rationale; do not start the full resume intake workflow.
expectations: Answers directly that a photo should generally not be included
Explains the Singapore fair-employment or job-relevance rationale
Does not launch a resume-writing intake questionnaire
Does not claim that every employer or every Asian market follows the same convention
Does not suggest replacing the photo with nationality, date of birth, race or NRIC/FIN details

evals.name: nanyang-mba-admissions-exception
evals.prompt: I am applying to the Nanyang MBA, not a job. I have eight years of experience and a two-and-a-half-page resume. Should I force it into one page? My draft has detailed technical project descriptions but very little leadership context.
evals.expected_output: Recognise the admissions-resume exception; do not force the one-page job-search rule; distinguish the current Nanyang MBA admissions page from the historical NBS three-page guidance; advise checking the current portal; prioritise concise leadership, collaboration and career progression over technical detail.
expectations: Recognises that this is an admissions resume rather than a job-search resume
Does not apply the standard one-page postgraduate job-resume rule
Explains that the current public Nanyang MBA admissions page asks for a concise career-progression CV but does not publicly state a page cap
Attributes the up-to-three-page guidance to an older NBS source and tells the user to verify the current application portal
Recommends reducing technical detail and adding leadership, collaboration and career-path evidence
Makes clear that even under the historical three-page ceiling, the content must remain concise, relevant and easy to scan
Avoids promising admission outcomes
